# Slash Medical

> > Wholesale drug test manufacturer specializing in FDA/CLIA-waived multi-panel screening solutions, OEM manufacturing, and rapid diagnostic products including FENTASCAN fentanyl detection and COVID-19 testing supplies.

Slash Medical provides comprehensive drug testing solutions for employers, healthcare facilities, and harm reduction programs. The company offers private label and OEM manufacturing options for bulk medical supplies, with products ranging from 1-panel to 20-panel drug test cups and specialized fentanyl detection systems.

## Key Topics

- Multi-panel drug screening (5, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 20 panel tests)
- FENTASCAN and FENT ALERT fentanyl detection
- FDA and CLIA waived drug tests
- Urine drug testing and screening
- Drug test cups and dip cards
- Wholesale drug testing and bulk orders
- OEM manufacturing and private label options
- Workplace and employer drug testing
- Adulterant detection
- Harm reduction programs
- COVID-19 rapid testing (Boson)
- CLIA compliance and certification
- Onsite drug testing solutions
- Rapid diagnostic test kits
